description: Executable Pending single-Spark OpenAI-compatible text-and-image recipe for Meta Muse Glimmer 30B NVFP4 (RedHatAI W4A4) with the official Meta DFlash drafter, FP8 KV cache and the muse_glimmer reasoning/tool parsers, following the MiaAI-Lab DGX Spark launch profile on the official vLLM 0.30.0 ARM64 image. Context defaults to the model's native 131072 (upstream's 262144 needs an unmerged RoPE-cache patch on a vLLM fork). Chat, vision, reasoning, tool calling and DFlash speedup remain Candidate capabilities; upstream throughput figures are its own claims. Memory follows the creator's settings: gpu-memory-utilization 0.42, as in MiaAI-Lab's start.sh at 1b71dc01 (line 37). The steady per-node peak is 0.42 x 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus 8 GB for CUDA context, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers (a speculative draft is profiled inside the utilization budget); the reserve is 8 GB, and admission keeps the platform memory floor free beside the peak. Chat template: the checkpoint's own (sha256 114f55eb, revision e83ead54) with one change in render_reasoning: a request that sets enable_thinking or thinking to false renders 'Reasoning strength: low.' (the creator's README: low for simple tasks) instead of the always-high default; without the flag the creator's reasoning_strength / high is unchanged. The unmodified template never reads either flag, so the model reasoned until finish_reason=length with null content (smoke V7, sweeps 2026-10-17 and 2026-10-30).
title: Muse Glimmer 30B NVFP4 DFlash vLLM Mia single Spark
